sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, gp.RetailPrice AS retailPrice, gp.SalesPrice AS salesPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 gpr.RetailPrice, gpr.SalesPrice, gpr.PriceListId FROM dbo.ZnodePrice gpr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList gpl ON gpl.PriceListId = gpr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal gpo ON gpo.PriceListId = gpl.PriceListId WHERE gpr.SKU = p.SKU AND gpo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (gpl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR gpl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (gpl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR gpl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (gpr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR gpr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (gpr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR gpr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY gpo.Precedence, gpl.PriceListId, gpr.PriceId) gp WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND p.OutOfStockOptions = @outOfStockOption AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = p.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId), @zero) <= @zero AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT rq.PimAddOnProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (@priceAbove IS NULL OR gp.RetailPrice > @priceAbove) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
